lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. What's the electrical doing?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Breaker in the kitchen keeps tripping. Third time today.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Third time — okay, it's telling on itself. Any burning smell, or warm outlets anywhere?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, nothing like that. It just—

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Good — no smell means no emergency. If that ever changes, that's a nine-one-one first, then us.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: So what do you charge to look at it?

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Panel-and-circuit inspection is seventy-five, and it's applied to any work we do. I've got Thursday at two P-M open.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thursday, two P-M — you're on the schedule. Texting your confirmation now.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Leave that breaker off till we're out, Dave. Better safe.
